title: Offline backup of the Android signing key
summary: Back up `upload-keystore.jks` and its passwords to a safe place outside the repo.
why: If this key is lost, you must file a key reset request with Google to upload updates to Play (it takes days). Even if the repo is private, a single copy is not to be trusted (RULES.md Section 15.7).

steps.title: Copy the two files to a password manager or an encrypted disk
steps.detail: 1Password / Bitwarden *Secure Note + attachment*, or an encrypted USB drive. Do not put them unencrypted in a cloud folder.

steps.title: Check that **App signing** is enabled in Play Console
steps.detail: **Test and release → Setup → App signing**: *Google Play App Signing* must be enabled; that way, even if the upload key is lost, the app signing key stays safe with Google.

fields.label: I **backed up** the keystore and its passwords to a safe place outside the repo
